Name: Tenkai Recessed Garden Pots
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
Make room for more plants without giving up room to walk.
Tenkai Recessed Garden Pots turns your sheds, cellar, and other suitable indoor spaces into compact growing areas with planters that sit flush with the floor. Walk across your plants, reach every tile, and harvest without leaving corridors between rows of ordinary Garden Pots. Even trellis crops remain walkable.
Adjacent planters of the same style join automatically. Their internal borders disappear, creating a continuous planting bed with an outer frame. Build long rows, rectangles, or L-shaped gardens. Borders update whenever you add or remove a planter, while different styles keep their own edges.
Choose from four designs: [b]Wood, Stone, Terracotta, and Hardwood[/b].
Learn the original Garden Pot recipe from Evelyn after restoring the Greenhouse. The mod then unlocks all four recessed planter recipes automatically. Existing saves that already know the original recipe receive the new recipes as well.
These planters are obtained through crafting only. Pierre does not sell them.
Each recipe converts [b]10 empty ordinary Garden Pots into 10 recessed planters[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Wood:[/b] 10 Garden Pots + 1 Wood.[/*]
[*][b]Stone:[/b] 10 Garden Pots + 1 Stone.[/*]
[*][b]Terracotta:[/b] 10 Garden Pots + 1 Clay.[/*]
[*][b]Hardwood:[/b] 10 Garden Pots + 1 Hardwood.[/*]
[/list]Use newly crafted pots or pick up empty pots you already own. Ingredients can be combined from your backpack and supported crafting chests. Existing recessed planters are not consumed as ordinary pots, and pots containing crops, bushes, fertilizer, or stored produce are excluded.
Plant seeds, apply fertilizer, water, and harvest using normal Garden Pot interactions. Indoor crops can grow in any season; outdoor crops follow the location’s normal seasonal rules.
Water with a watering can or use retaining soil. Sprinklers do not water these pots, and Ancient Seeds remain unsupported. Removing a planted pot destroys its crop, just as it does with an ordinary Garden Pot.
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.10 or later[/b]. Tested with SMAPI 4.5.2. Content Patcher is not required. English and Spanish item text is included.
To install, close the game, extract the [b]TenkaiMacetasEmpotradas[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder, and launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
Existing recessed planters retain their design when updating. If you uninstall, the pots revert to ordinary solid Garden Pots, so leave an open walking route beforehand.
Created by [b]Tenkai Tenshi[/b]. Visual assets were created with AI assistance and adapted into the mod’s sprite atlas.
Local native checks and SMAPI startup have passed. Full in-save acceptance and multiplayer validation are still pending. Back up your save before trying a new mod.
